_meta.description: Trap pool for lockpick failures (2026-09-03). Every failed chest pick fires a random trap from the chest's OWN tier (not the floor tier -- that was a bug pre-v2.6.6). Trap severity scales with chest tier: T1 small penalty, T5 potentially lethal. Damage is roll_dice notation; effect is a canonical status_effects debuff; effect_duration is turns. Each tier has 4-5 variants for flavor variety.

1.message: A poisoned needle springs from the lock!
A coiled spring smacks your hand!
A thin dart nicks your palm -- red beads well up.
A puff of stale dust clouds your eyes.
The lid whips open on a rusted hinge -- your fingers catch it.

2.message: A puff of dazing gas billows out!
A jet of acid sprays across the lock!
A wave of cold slaps down through the chest -- your fingers stiffen.
A soporific mist rises -- you struggle to stay awake.

3.message: A bolt of electricity surges through you!
A freezing mist clamps around you!
A gout of flame licks up from the seam!
A cruel spike drives through your wrist!
A whispered hex slides out of the wood -- a small darkness clings to you.

4.message: Dark energy erupts from the lock!
A gout of flame washes over you!
A grey-cold hand reaches out and takes some of your warmth.
A binding hex slams into you -- something clings.
A ward of silence snaps over you -- no sound will come.

5.message: Flames erupt from the chest, searing you!
A killing rune flares -- your limbs lock up!
A gorgon-glyph on the lid meets your eye -- stone begins to crawl up your arm.
A great sigil flares; unseen chains snap around you.
A dragon-sigil roars white -- the whole chest is furnace-hot for a beat.
